kpis.description_fr: Merchandise = chemicals + automotive + forest + ag products. Plus gros segment CSX. Diversifié, marges les plus hautes.
kpis.description_en: Merchandise = chemicals + automotive + forest + ag products. CSX's largest segment. Diversified, highest margins.

kpis.description_fr: Intermodal = containers + trailers (transport multimodal). Cyclique sur trafic conteneurs ports USA.
kpis.description_en: Intermodal = containers + trailers (multimodal). Cyclical on US port container traffic.

kpis.description_fr: Coal = thermique + métallurgique. Déclin séculaire mais cycle export coal Mid-Atlantic résilient.
kpis.description_en: Coal = thermal + metallurgical. Secular decline but resilient Mid-Atlantic export coal cycle.

kpis.description_fr: Operating Ratio = OpEx / Revenue. Plus bas = meilleur. CSX historiquement n°1 efficacité parmi Class I railroads.
kpis.description_en: Operating Ratio = OpEx / Revenue. Lower = better. CSX historically #1 efficiency among Class I railroads.

kpis.description_fr: Volume total carloads transportés. KPI structurel rail. Stagnation modérée volumes mais pricing power.
kpis.description_en: Total carloads transported. Structural rail KPI. Moderate volume stagnation but pricing power.

kpis.description_fr: Capex ~18 % du CA = investissement réseau (ponts, locomotives, technologies PTC + automation). Capital-intensive.
kpis.description_en: Capex ~18% of revenue = network investment (bridges, locomotives, PTC tech + automation). Capital-intensive.
